meaning: cuvier: almost certainly for Georges Cuvier (1769–1832)
description: A bulky shark with a blunt, broad head and a long upper tail lobe. Dark bars down its flanks give it its name and fade as it grows. It eats almost anything, from fish and rays to sea turtles and seabirds.
eats: Fish, rays, sea turtles, seabirds and carrion
